description:
Other sites' links, from the backlink index: one of the month's backlink lookups per call (an answer from the last 7 days is free unless refresh, and usage says what's left). The site's own profile is get_backlinks profile, free.
lookup:
- profile(domain, refresh?): Who links to a site: domain rating, links, referring sites, spam score, the 25 strongest.
- gap(rivals, refresh?): Pages linking to every rival named (one to three) and not to the site, strongest first: pitch them with update_outreach add.
- metrics(targets): Link metrics for up to 50 domains or pages.
name: research_backlinks
title: Research backlinks
